desc: We hereby inform that the Bank has allotted 6,47,261 equity shares of face value of Rs. 10/- each on August 25, 2026, pursuant to exercise of equivalent number of Employee Stock Options under the ESOPs as per the attached submissions.

Intimation regarding proceedings of the first Extraordinary General Meeting of slice small finance bank limited for the Financial year 2026-27, pursuant to Regulation 51(2) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
